purpose: Optional engineering extension; no new confirmatory statistical claim.

price_observation.comparison: Freeze usage and compare matched price identities; missing or changed units are unpriced, never zero.
price_observation.promotion: A candidate is preserved separately and reviewed before becoming a new locked price book.

assumptions: Identical work and service quality across scenarios
Capacity may scale down each hour

carbon.basis: GPU-only operational electricity estimate; not measured energy and not total lifecycle carbon
carbon.region_proxy: EPA eGRID2023 SRVC for the modeled eastus region; provider facility location is not verified
carbon.power: NVIDIA T4 70W nameplate; full nameplate for allocated device hours

guardrail.mode: Public isolated simulation budgets; decision and reservation only, no training execution
guardrail.forecast: Locked hourly GPU rate times requested GPU count, duration and attempts, rounded upward to integer microdollars
guardrail.policy: Refuse above remaining budget; exact equality allowed; fail closed on unknown input; idempotency payload must match
checks: Repeated request does not reserve twice

readback.contract: CSV tables, dictionary, catalog and SHA-256 warehouse lock; no private database connection
